title: Lens and Lattice: Altered Perception, the Internal Arts, and the Science of a Curious Practice
creator: Cory Snell
description:
A free, evidence-based companion to the System of Inevitability, Book 4: practising the internal arts with curiosity in altered states, responsibly; the science of psilocybin, perception, touch, pattern finding, and integration. Harm reduction, not promotion. By Cory Snell, creator of the System of Inevitability. Book 4 of the series Companions to the System of Inevitability.

Also in this series, Companions to the System of Inevitability:

  • Book 1: Walking and Turning
  • Book 2: Wave and Return
  • Book 3: Shape and Choice
  • Book 5: Nucleus and Orbit
